newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt o/n rates steady as market masses pounds.
newsitem.headline: Egypt o/n rates steady as market masses pounds.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound were steady in the private-sector market on Thursday at between eight and nine percent, the same as Wednesday's range, as the market accumulated liquidity.
One of the four bankers said he placed "a very small amount" overnight at 9-1/16 percent.
One-week rates were lower at eight to nine percent compared to 8-3/4 to 9-1/2 on Wednesday, but the bankers did not deal.
"The market is very liquid. There are plenty of Egyptian pounds as many banks have been refused treasury bills," he said.
"This is a clear indication that the government wants a low interest rate," said another banker.
The interbank market has been accumulating liquidity since last week, partly because of the Central Bank's auction of 91-day t-bills, at which it accepted few bids.
Public-sector banks kept their rates at 10-1/2 percent.
